scope: One fixed scorer, one historical-universe specification and one 7-day horizon. No parameter changes, no repeated model search, no external investment benchmark. The active prospective observer, its training and its ledger remain unchanged.
prior_consumption: 2021-2023 training and 2024-2026 outcome data were already consumed in earlier Discovery. Current universe expansion and payoff objective are adaptive. This retrospective diagnostic must not be described as an untouched independent test, a point-in-time live replay or a profitability proof.
universe: Use all USDT symbol prefixes in the already-recorded paginated Binance historical archive catalog, not present-day exchangeInfo survivors. Exclude the original declared fiat/stable/wrapped/metal base list plus RLUSD, allow BTC as a candidate, and use explicit known leveraged-product families rather than generic suffixes. No 240-symbol cap. Eligibility at each historical decision uses only the same delayed 90-day positive complete OHLCV window and median 30-day quote volume >=5 million USDT. Require >=10 eligible candidates. Historical archive retention, identities and actual trading restrictions are not certified complete.

data.source: Reuse frozen normalized/raw original pair histories where available; acquire the remaining archive-catalog symbols using the same public REST pagination and checksum-verified archive fallback. Preserve original raw retrieval known_at and record actual retrieval known_at for new requests. No interpolation or survivor-only filtering.
data.training: Exact SHA-verified repaired 2021-2023 training artifact used by the active observer, including censored neighbors; do not add newly collected symbols to training.

decisions: Every Monday from 2024-01-01 through 2026-08-31; 140 consecutive weekly slots ending 2026-09-06. Entry-year summaries assign the full seven-day outcome to its entry year, including 2024-12-30 through 2025-01-05. Features end at Saturday close, with at least 24 hours of delay. Scoring receives only past features and fixed training payoffs; write the complete decision ledger before attaching evaluation outcomes.
model: Unchanged kNN200 geometry, original 8 features and payoff_summary. Rank strictly positive fixed heuristic scores, ties by symbol; select at most five, each 20% of beginning-of-week simulated equity. Unused allocation has zero USDT yield. Fewer than 10 eligible or no qualifying score means no entry. No forcing trades, refit or hindsight threshold reduction.
price_proxy: Historical daily Monday open to Sunday close, not actual fills or the live observer's later request-time depth VWAP. Confirm positive complete seven-day bars as in the existing outcome function; preserve missingness. This measures the fixed selection rule with a daily price proxy, not certified execution parity.
identity: Apply only the 13 previously documented exact-horizon identity resolutions where applicable. All additional missing/ambiguous outcomes remain censored, not silently deleted or replaced by -100%/zero. A selected censored outcome makes the measured portfolio result unknown. Separately report predeclared total-loss and flat-gross-recovery scenarios retaining its original 20% weight; neither is an estimate or a universal bound on recovery.

costs.factor: (1+gross_return) * [(1-fee)*(1-extra_slippage)]^(1+sell_legs). Direct USDT exit uses one sell leg; a verified cross-quote exit uses two. Buy fees are deducted from acquired base, sell fees from proceeds, matching the declared v4 mark convention. Score itself remains at its frozen v2 cost convention; changing cost scenarios never reranks.
costs.missing: Actual historical spread, depth, impact, fee tiers, outages, tax and BRL conversion are unmeasured. Return figures are USDT price-proxy simulations after assumed trading costs, not realized investor net profit.

metrics: hypothetical 5000 USDT ending equity and profit/loss
selected holdings, active weeks and cash weeks
complete/positive/negative/zero selected trade counts and win rate among complete selected observations

uncertainty: If nonconstant, completely observed weekly log returns exist, report a descriptive 4-week circular-block bootstrap mean interval with 5000 replicates and seed 20260907. It is conditional, not calibrated for the full adaptive search history. All-cash data means no trading evidence: do not report zero risk, perfect accuracy or a meaningful profitability interval. No full-market refutation from absence of selected signals.
decision_rule: Zero selected holdings => NO_TRADING_EVIDENCE_RULE_ABSTAINS. Any selected censored outcome => INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_FIDELITY for measured compounded profit. Otherwise nonpositive primary net return => NOT_PROFITABLE_IN_THIS_DIAGNOSTIC. Positive primary but fewer than 30 active weeks => POSITIVE_BUT_SPARSE. Otherwise => POSITIVE_HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_PROOF. These labels do not promote a strategy or certify future profitability.
